source: current public Naver Place menu; prefer 대표 entries
selection: Select food-first representative signals with meaningfully different dishes or preparations.
Allow at most one beverage signal, only when it materially represents the venue.
Never include a broad beverage and a branded/subtype beverage from the same family together.
If fewer than three verified distinct signals exist, render fewer; never invent filler.
normalization: Remove price, portions, counts, size, meal period, and event copy without changing dish identity.
Use a compact display name of 12 characters or fewer so each mobile menu chip stays on one line; preserve the complete original in source.
Examples: 수제교자 5p → 수제교자; 대표 고급양갈비 2+1 → 고급양갈비.
mobileRendering: Render at most three verified menu chips with normal centered wrapping. Do not shrink chips or use a horizontal swipe rail unless the user explicitly approves it.
evidence: Each rendered menu chip must retain its exact Naver source menu string and source type (대표 or 등록).
